findings.title: console.log in committed code
findings.rule_text: No `console.log` in committed code; use the project logger instead.
findings.issue: console.log used instead of project logger.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace console.log with the project logger imported from ../logger.

findings.title: Unvalidated request body written to DB
findings.rule_text: Validate every handler's request body against a schema before using it. Never pass `req.body` straight into a database call.
findings.issue: req.body passed directly to db.user.create without schema validation.
findings.code_snippet:
const body = req.body;
return res.json(await db.user.create({ data: body }));
findings.suggested_fix: Validate req.body with a schema before the database call.
